To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the economics discipline has not been able to escape from its philosophical foundations and that it is impossible to understand the economics discipline without a thorough understanding of its philosophical foundations.
economics is a social science, not a physical science, and that the social sciences are not natural sciences.
the philosophy of economics has become a well established and flourishing sub-discipline of philosophy; it is also an important and rapidly growing area of research within economics itself.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the philosophical foundations of economics, and the philosophical implications of economic analysis.
the philosophical and methodological foundations of economics.
the nature and status of the economic models and theorems that constitute the central subject matter of economics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the economics and philosophy of economics have been and are being developed in a way that is both independent and interdependent, with each side of the equation having an impact on the other.
the economics-philosophy relationship has not been resolved, but that it is a relationship of mutual dependence and interaction.

there is a large and growing body of research on the philosophy of economics, and that the philosophy of economics has become a distinct sub-discipline in economics, philosophy, and even in other social sciences such as sociology, psychology, and political science.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have attempted to document the current state of the field in three important areas, namely the epistemology of economics, the ontology of economic phenomena and the ethics of economics.

we have been concerned to explore the extent to which philosophy can be of assistance to the economic theorist in the pursuit of his or her craft, and to examine the extent to which the economic theorist is already a philosopher, whether or not he or she knows it.
the Companion was a very useful resource, but that it could have done with more work on ontology and less on methodology.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in each of the areas we discuss, the philosophical issues involved are not just important for the philosophy of economics, but also for economics itself, and that the philosophy of economics can make a positive contribution to economics as an empirical science.
the philosophy of economics, as an academic discipline, has come of age.
the philosophy of economics is a rich and growing area of research.
